candidates.excerpt: Nepali and Filipino nationals killed, while Pakistani and Indian workers injured at Shaybah oil field in southeastern Saudi Arabia.

candidates.title: Ukraine’s strikes on Russian data centres disrupt key services, derail AI research
candidates.excerpt: Ukrainian drone attacks damaged major Russian data centres operated by Yandex, Sberbank and VKontakte, disrupting digital services nationwide. Experts warn that equipment losses, chip shortages and international sanctions could delay repairs and further hinder Russia’s artificial intelligence development ambitions

candidates.title: Why was Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann fined  ₹50,000 at Delhi airport? ' ₹2.5-lakh shoes, suits' — AAP, BJP in war of words
candidates.excerpt: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was returning from France when he was “forcefully” stopped at Delhi airport and allegedly fined ₹50,000.

candidates.title: BJP worker brutally attacked, shot dead in Bengal’s Malda; police detain one
candidates.excerpt: BJP worker Samir Ghosh was hacked and shot dead at his home in Malda’s English Bazar, West Bengal, on Wednesday night. Police detained one suspect and are investigating the murder amid political allegations and heightened local tensions

candidates.title: MP: Clash during Dussehra procession in Jabalpur leaves youth stabbed, cop injured; two held
candidates.excerpt: A clash during Jabalpur’s Garha Dussehra procession left youth Anurag Pandey stabbed and Sub-Inspector Sanjay Gurjar injured while intervening. Police detained two accused, citing old enmity as the suspected motive, and initiated an investigation under relevant BNS provisions

candidates.title: INDIA bloc huddle: Leaders to meet virtually on CEC row; SIR irregularities on agenda
candidates.excerpt: INDIA bloc leaders, including Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, will meet via video conferencing on Thursday. They will strategize regarding the Election Commission’s actions surrounding the electoral rolls. Opposition leaders have accused the Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of irregularities and demanded his resignation. The bloc plans to continue its campaign against perceived threats to democratic institutions and has submitted a memorandum outlining its demands.

candidates.title: Saudi authorities say two killed by falling debris at oil facility following drone attack in kingdom
candidates.excerpt: “Two people killed were Nepali and Filipino nationals, while the injured were Pakistani and Indian nationals,” says Ministry

candidates.title: Tummala faces flak for Deepavali remarks at Khammam meeting after video goes viral
candidates.excerpt: Agriculture Minister Tummala Nageswara Rao has come under criticism after a video of his remarks at a public meeting in Khammam went viral on social media. The Minister's sarcastic comment while asking attendees about the date of Deepavali drew sharp reactions from netizens.

candidates.title: Five held for burning Ravana effigies depicting CM, minister on Dasara in Siddipet
candidates.excerpt: Five persons were arrested by Koheda police for allegedly setting flexi effigies of Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy and BC Welfare Minister Ponnam Prabhakar on fire during Dasara celebrations in Dharma Sagar Pally village of Siddipet district.

candidates.title: Mysuru Dussehra Concludes with Grand Jamboo Savari Procession
candidates.excerpt: Keralam Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan and Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy attended the celebrations at the invitation of Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar. Several foreign dignitaries, including ambassadors, consuls general and high commissioners, also participated.

candidates.title: DRI busts Bangladesh-Kolkata-Hyderabad gold smuggling route, seizes Rs 5.84 crore haul
candidates.excerpt: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence arrested five people near Vijayawada after seizing gold and foreign currency worth Rs 5.84 crore. Officials allege the gold was smuggled from Bangladesh via Kolkata to Hyderabad. The agency also reported an earlier seizure near Visakhapatnam

candidates.title: Rupee falls 44 paise to close at 94.82 against US dollar
candidates.excerpt: The rupee fell 44 paise to close provisionally at 94.82 against the US dollar amid rising crude oil prices and weakness in domestic equities. Meanwhile, the dollar index eased, while Jio Platforms' IPO attracted strong investor demand on Thursday
